name: Zangen Stonehoof
summary: Zangen Stonehoof is a tauren keeper situated at the High Rise bonfire in the heart of Thunder Bluff. Dutiful and revered among his peers, he faithfully tends to the central flames each evening while coordinating efforts to aid his distant kin across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Keeper of the High Rise Flame
sections.body: Perched on the High Rise of Thunder Bluff, Zangen Stonehoof maintains the central communal bonfire that overlooks the city's highest bluffs. As twilight falls over Mulgore, Zangen kindles the fire, providing warmth and an enduring beacon for the tribes assembled beneath High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Beyond keeping the flames alight, he maintains ties with allies beyond Mulgore's mesa, acting as a liaison for spiritual and ritual endeavors taking place across the continent.

sections.title: Aiding the Cliffrunners
sections.body: Zangen acts as an intermediary for Rau Cliffrunner, an associate stationed south in Thousand Needles. When Rau required the mystical waters of a night elf moonwell for sacred rituals, Zangen enlisted dependable Horde adventurers to brave the contested forests of Ashenvale. By securing the filled phial from the ancient groves and dispatching it south to Freewind Post, Zangen plays a quiet but pivotal part in preserving ancient rites and assisting scattered tauren posts.

faq.answer: Zangen Stonehoof is a tauren resident of Thunder Bluff found beside the large central bonfire on the High Rise. He tends the fire each evening and assists distant kin by organizing aid and courier tasks across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What does Zangen do with the bonfire?
aliases: why is zangen near the fire
faq.answer: Every evening around nightfall, Zangen lights the great bonfire situated in front of him on the High Rise, providing light and warmth to the upper terrace of the bluff.

faq.q: Why does Zangen need moonwell water from Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Zangen acts on behalf of Rau Cliffrunner, who is stationed at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Rau requires water from an Ashenvale moonwell for a sacred ritual, and Zangen tasks capable travelers with obtaining it and carrying it southward.

faq.q: Where can Zangen Stonehoof be found?
faq.answer: He stands in the center of the High Rise in Thunder Bluff, right next to the communal fire pit on the upper mesa.

angles.text: Zangen embodies the interconnectedness of the tribes, linking Mulgore's civic center directly to distant kin like the Cliffrunners out in Thousand Needles.
For travelers visiting the great mesa of Thunder Bluff, Zangen offers a point of contact for venturing outward into contested regions like Ashenvale.
